{{Quote|She's not dead, though whatever's left of her mind surely begs for death.|Darth Zannah to [[Hetton]] on the effects of Summon Fears on Cyndra|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
Similar to [[Mind trick/Legends|Force Fear]], [[Mind trick/Legends|horror]], [[Mind trick/Legends|insanity]], or [[Memory Walk|Torture by Chagrin]], '''summon fear''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] conjured through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], that caused the victim to experience their worst fears to the point of hysteria. It was a very powerful ability, and the duration and intensity varied depending on the caster.

This spell was called upon when the caster moved their fingers in an intricate pattern, likely focusing [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in a particular way, taking seconds to produce effects. The victim's deepest and most primal fears were made seemingly alive, often taking the form of demons or monsters that relentlessly torment the victim. The longer the spell is held, the more realistic and terrifying the illusions became. To an outside viewer, the victim may seem to suddenly seize and go insane.

Depending on the spell's length, the effects could range greatly. Short durations could result in the victim waking up with only a small recollection of what happened. Longer applications could cause one's physical form to seize itself into unconsciousness, while the mind was virtually destroyed. The body remained effectively comatose, while whatever lasting consciousness was tortured for all eternity. Spells even longer endured could very well result in the victim's death.

Revan used this technique during his quest to kill Tenebrae.<ref>[[The Old Republic: Revan|''The Old Republic: Revan'']]</ref>

[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], was a master of this ability. She first used it against the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cyndra]], causing the woman to immediately go insane and tear her own eyes out. She used it again when [[Duel on Tython|dueling]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sarro Xaj]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], and [[Confrontation on Ambria|again shortly after that]], against her own cousin, [[Darovit]].<ref>''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> [[980 BBY|Ten years later]], she applied it against her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], during their [[Duel on Ambria (980 BBY)|fatal duel]]; however, Bane was able to conquer his fears long ago and, after a few moments, resisted the spell.<ref>''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], while [[Mission to Ralltiir|attacking]] a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun Fortress|fortress]] on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] used the spell on an [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] bodyguard when the latter tried to invade the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak's]] mind.<ref>[[Darth Maul (2000) 4|''Darth Maul (2000) 4'']]</ref>
